description: This file defines a thread-safe queue template class 'ThreadSafeQueue' with push, pop, and capacity management functionalities, including handling maximum element limits and associated callbacks.

classes.name: ThreadSafeQueue
classes.description: A template class providing a thread-safe queue with push and pop operations, capacity limits, and optional handler for when the queue reaches maximum size.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the front element of the queue, waiting if the queue is empty.

methods.name: PopAll
methods.description: Removes and returns all elements from the queue as a deque, waiting if the queue is empty.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Attempts to add an element to the queue; returns false if the queue is at capacity and the handler did not free space.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: IsFull
methods.description: Checks if the queue has reached its maximum capacity.
